title: Research Report Agent
tagline: Turn a question and a pile of documents into a report where every sentence can be checked.
summary: Build the pipeline behind deep research tools: search a corpus, pull exact snippets, plan the research, write only from evidence, verify every claim, publish an HTML report with footnotes and a trace, then score it on checked-in public evaluation fixtures.
usefulFor: Prepare a technical decision memo whose claims link to the supporting source passages.
Compare reports after source documents change and inspect which claims need revision.
youWillBuild: An evidence ledger for technical decisions showing how source updates change published claims.

stages.title: Search the corpus
stages.summary: Load markdown documents with headers and rank them with BM25.
stages.languageWhy: Rust owns ranking and JSON parsing; Python exposes a small process adapter to later stages.

stages.title: Extract snippets you can cite
stages.summary: Split documents into sentences and keep exact character offsets for every snippet.
stages.languageWhy: Python string slices preserve the exact evidence spans used by the verifier.

stages.title: Plan the research
stages.summary: Split the question into facets with a rule planner, then swap in a recorded model safely.
stages.languageWhy: A Python protocol isolates planning from live model transport and recorded replies.

stages.title: Write only from evidence
stages.summary: Compose sections from snippets and reject any sentence without a valid citation.
stages.languageWhy: Python dataclasses keep snippets, sections and citation references explicit.

stages.title: Verify every claim
stages.summary: Catch swapped names, flipped negations and changed numbers, under a run budget.
stages.languageWhy: Python sets and counters make support rules and budgets inspectable.

stages.title: Publish the report
stages.summary: Render HTML with numbered footnotes and write a trace of the whole run.
stages.languageWhy: Python serializes evidence; TypeScript validates it and renders accessible HTML.

stages.title: Score the public fixtures
stages.summary: Measure citation precision, source recall and fact coverage on checked-in public evaluation fixtures.
stages.languageWhy: Python computes per-question metrics and a reproducible aggregate score.

languageReasons.why: Build the BM25 index and parse JSON requests using only the standard library.
Compose evidence extraction, recorded model calls, verification and evaluation.
Validate the evidence contract and render an interactive, portable HTML report.
